blocks.title: Bubble sort
blocks.text: Bubble Sort baar baar list se guzarta, saath wali cheezon ka muwazna karta aur ghalat tarteeb mein hon to jagah badalta hai, jab tak mazeed tabadla zaroori na rahe.

Bubble Sort O(n^2) hai, to bare datasets ke liye na-kaarkard hai, magar samajhna aasan aur taleem aur chhote datasets ke liye mufeed hai. Bare datasets ke liye Quick Sort ya Merge Sort jaise zyada kaarkard algorithms istemal karein (Tip).

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa algorithm list se baar baar guzar kar ghalat tarteeb wali saath wali cheezein badal kar tarteeb deta hai (MCQ 7)?
Bubble Sort ka amal aur time complexity samjhaiye aur kisi aur sorting algorithm se muwazna kijiye (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: Har chakkar har saath wale jore ka muwazna kar ke ghalat tarteeb wale badalta hai, to baqi sab se bari qeemat aakhir tak pohanchti hai; zyada se zyada n - 1 chakkar, har ek mein zyada se zyada n - 1 muwazne, to O(n^2) waqt. Merge Sort list ko aadhon mein baant kar tarteeb deta aur jorta hai, O(n log n). 1,000 cheezon ke liye bubble sort ko taqreeban 500,000 muwazne, merge sort ko sirf taqreeban 10,000, to bari lists ke liye merge sort kahin behtar hai; bubble sort saada hai aur izafi memory nahi chahta.

items: Bubble sort: chakkar ba chakkar saath wale jore badlo; [5, 3, 8, 4, 2] se [2, 3, 4, 5, 8]; O(n^2).
